_comment: Reference handshape templates for ASL fingerspelling. Populated from TemplateRecorder output. Each sample keeps BOTH representations: 'normalized' is the 78-dim feature vector the classifier consumes (26 landmarks x 3 axes, wrist-origin, orthonormal basis from wrist->middleKnuckle and the knuckle spread, scaled by the wrist->middleKnuckle distance); 'raw' is the 78 unmodified world-space coordinates in centimetres, x/y/z per landmark in landmarkOrder. Raw is kept because discarding it is irreversible once the hardware session ends - it is what allows landmark-space jitter, re-normalization against a different basis, validating normalizeLandmarks against real hands, and augmentation. See docs/JOINTS.md and Assets/Scripts/LandmarkCapture.ts.
